rationales.deterministic-orchestration-v2: form (a) + form (b) — the outermost Node.js orchestrator advances every milestone through the fixed Strategy → Execution → Verification sequence, invoking LLM manager teams for each phase. It also deterministically routes Apollo's verdict: failure returns control to Execution with the budget halved until pass or exhaustion, while pass advances to the next Strategy phase. The evaluated implementation ran this lifecycle across benchmark and multi-day projects without requiring a human to advance it.
